title: 影子跟读特训：十四个核心句，刻进嘴型
anchor: Shadowing drill — reuse of EP1–EP5 core sentences
takeaway: 每天跟读一轮，直到不看稿也能脱口而出。

lines: Bruce，影子跟读特训，开始。规则很简单：每句话，先听母语者读一遍，停顿的时候，你立刻跟着读一遍。重点不是单词，是节奏、连读和语调——像影子一样贴着他。每句话跟读完就过了，不许回头纠结。十四个核心句，全部来自前五集。准备好了吗？开始。

blocks.text: Every student learns English at school.
Technology has changed how I learn—it's made everything more accessible.
I'm not much of a shopping person.
Off the top of my head, I'd say my city could use more parks.
My watch tells me how many calories I've burned.
I watched my first live show in a huge stadium, and the vibe was unreal.
Smartphones are a double-edged sword. That said, with self-discipline, kids can handle them.
I'd go as far as to say that AI will reshape education.
It really depends on how well a kid can discipline themselves.
That's a good question—let me think for a second.
Music is how I set my mood—it starts my day on the right foot.
I made the switch from chemistry to computer science, and honestly, it's the best decision I've made.

lines: 十四句，全部拿下。最后一遍，闭上眼睛，不看任何稿子，在脑子里把这十四句再过一遍。能回忆起几句？明天再听这条带，目标是全部。影子跟读的意义就在于：嘴型比记忆更长寿。Bruce，特训完成。
